name: voice-profile-build
output_directory: private profile_dir from ownvoice config show, or explicit --profile-dir outside git
cross_register_input: separate CROSS_REGISTER delimited block from cross-register.json, counted in Stage S ceiling
core_voice_response: list of {group_id, pattern, quotes: [{register, quote}]}, 2-3 exact group quotes spanning at least two registers
article_input: SHA-256 bound profiled-articles.jsonl, article-only chunks, fixed article sample; stats-only sends no article text
no_eligible_sources: skip Q; omit exemplars and phrase tables; stats-only profile
claude: tools empty, strict empty MCP config, empty temporary cwd
codex: read-only sandbox, network off, web search disabled, empty temporary cwd; true no-tools mode unverified
